name: auto_market_scan
purpose: Read-only catalog SKU/category join to deduplicated paid settle rows. Query and category intersect; shop filters seller, never buyer. Returns total match counts and recent rows.
evidence: made by tool_forge.py: Repeated category-ledger and catalog-to-ledger searches are a strong fit for one combined read-only search. It returns matching catalog entries and recent relevant ledger rows, including deals for catalog SKUs; it does not claim to replace purchase-history calls.
